items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Valerie in the context of a plan to have her play, but the INTERVIEWEE does not respond with any personal connection or knowledge of Valerie.

ctx.x: I'm talking about those old records we have, darling. You know those old-

Oh, yeah, we have a plan now. I'm going to ask Valerie, did he want my little daughter? She changed to play a little piece. She just started music in October. And she played Mighty Like a Rose. And I'm trying to get her in here to play for you all. Oh, yeah, that's happening.
Come on now. Come on, darling. Now, don't do that.
